topics.title: Introduction & Concept of Exempt Supply
explain: Supplies within charging purview are checked for exemptions to fix final tax liability.
Exempt supply includes nil rated supplies, wholly exempted supplies, and non-taxable supplies.
Non-taxable supply is a supply not leviable to tax under CGST or IGST Act.
Alcoholic liquor for human consumption and five specified petroleum products are non-taxable supplies.
Exemptions can apply to specified activities, suppliers, recipients, or combined supplier-recipient pairs.

flow.title: Determining Exempt Supply Status
steps: Check if supply attracts NIL tax rate
Check if wholly exempted by notification
Check if classified as non-taxable supply
If any condition met supply is exempt

topics.example: Fresh unpackaged milk and alcoholic liquor for human consumption are both classified as exempt supplies under GST law.
remember: Exempt supply = Nil rated + Wholly exempt + Non-taxable supply.
mistakes: Thinking non-taxable supply is excluded from exempt supply; Section 2(47) explicitly includes non-taxable supplies.

quiz.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of 'Exempt Supply' under Section 2(47)?
o: Only supplies attracting nil rate of tax
Nil rated, wholly exempt, and non-taxable supplies
quiz.why: Section 2(47) defines exempt supply as nil rated, wholly exempt, and non-taxable supplies.

quiz.q: Which of these is classified as a non-taxable supply under GST?
quiz.why: Alcoholic liquor for human consumption is outside the scope of GST leverage and is a non-taxable supply under Section 2(78).

topics.title: Power to Grant Exemption & Regularization of Short Levy
explain: Government can grant general exemption by notification in public interest on GST Council recommendations.
Exemption by notification can be absolute (unconditional and mandatory) or conditional (optional).
Special orders grant exemption in exceptional circumstances for specific individual cases.
Clarificatory explanations inserted within 1 year of notification take retrospective effect from entry inception.
Under Section 11A, non-levy or short-levy arising from general trade practice can be regularized without recovery.

flow.title: Mechanism of Granting Tax Exemption
steps: GST Council recommends tax exemption to Government
Government issues notification in public interest
Absolute exemption becomes mandatory for taxpayers
Conditional exemption remains optional for taxpayers
Special order issued for exceptional cases

topics.example: A clarification inserted by notification 10 months after an exemption entry was created applies retrospectively from the date the entry was introduced.
remember: Explanations inserted within 1 year of notification apply retrospectively from inception of the entry.
mistakes: Assuming absolute exemption allows a taxpayer to choose to pay tax; absolute exemption is strictly mandatory.

quiz.q: If a supply is unconditionally exempted from the whole of tax by notification, what choice does the supplier have?
o: Supplier can choose to pay full tax
Supplier can choose to pay partial tax
Supplier has no option and must not collect tax
Supplier must apply for special order
quiz.why: Absolute/unconditional exemption is mandatory in nature and the supplier cannot choose to collect tax.

quiz.q: Within what period must an explanation be inserted into a notification for it to have retrospective effect?
quiz.why: Section 11(3) allows the Government to insert an explanation within 1 year to take retrospective effect.

topics.title: Overview of Goods Exempt from Tax
explain: Essential items used for everyday public consumption are notified as exempt from GST.
Exempt goods include fresh milk, curd, lassi, fresh vegetables, unbranded flour, and unpacked food grains.
Other exempt goods include live fish, potatoes, fresh grapes, plastic bangles, and Indian National Flag.
If everyday items like food grains or curd are pre-packaged and pre-labelled, exemption may not apply.

flow.title: Checking Exemption for Essential Goods
steps: Identify the item being supplied
Check if item is essential unbranded food
Verify item presence in Section 11(1) list
Supply is wholly exempt from tax

topics.example: Selling loose, unpackaged curd over the counter to a retail customer is completely exempt from GST.
remember: Unpackaged and unbranded essential daily food items are generally exempt from GST.
mistakes: Assuming all food items are exempt regardless of whether they are pre-packaged and pre-labelled.

quiz.q: Which of the following items is exempt from GST when sold loose and unpackaged?
quiz.why: Fresh milk, curd, lassi, and unpacked food items are specifically notified as exempt goods.

quiz.q: Which national symbol is specifically exempt from GST?
quiz.why: Indian National Flag (HSN 63) is specifically included in the list of goods exempt from tax.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Charitable & Religious Activities
explain: Services by Section 12AA/12AB registered entities by way of defined charitable activities are exempt.
Charitable activities cover public health, religion/yoga, education for needy groups, and environmental protection.
Conduct of any religious ceremony is exempt for all service providers.
Renting precincts of religious places is exempt if charges are below limits (room < ₹1,000/day, hall < ₹10,000/day, shop < ₹10,000/month).
Specified religious pilgrimages (KMVN for Kailash-Mansarovar, Haj Committee) and sports training by charitable trusts are exempt.

flow.title: Charitable Entity Exemption Test
steps: Verify entity registration under Section 12AA or 12AB
Check if activity matches defined charitable activities
If matched grant exemption under Entry 1
If outside definition tax applies under GST

topics.example: A religious trust renting a community hall in temple precincts for ₹9,000 per day is exempt as rent is below ₹10,000 per day.
remember: Precinict Rent Thresholds: Room < ₹1,000/day, Premises/Hall < ₹10,000/day, Shop < ₹10,000/month.
mistakes: Believing all income of a Section 12AA/12AB trust is automatically exempt; only defined 'charitable activities' qualify.

quiz.q: Renting of commercial shops in temple precincts is exempt from GST if the monthly rent per shop is less than:
quiz.why: Entry 13(b) exempts renting of shops in precincts of religious places if charges are less than ₹10,000 per month.

quiz.q: Training or coaching in recreational activities is exempt from GST under Entry 80 when provided by an individual in:
quiz.why: Entry 80 exempts training/coaching in recreational activities relating to arts or culture when provided by an individual.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Agriculture Related Services
explain: Cultivation of plants and rearing of animals (except horses) for food, fibre, fuel, or raw material are exempt.
Farm operations, farm labour, non-altering farm processes, agro-machinery/land leasing, and extension services are exempt.
Loading, unloading, packing, storage, or warehousing of agricultural produce, rice, cereals, pulses, fruits, and vegetables are exempt.
Services by Agricultural Produce Marketing Committees (APMC) or commission agents for farm produce are exempt.
Custom milling of paddy into rice is NOT exempt because it alters essential characteristics and occurs post-harvest.

flow.title: Agricultural Service Exemption Evaluation
steps: Check relation to cultivation or non-horse animal rearing
Ensure farm processes do not alter produce characteristics
Confirm produce is marketable for primary market
Apply exemption if essential characteristics remain unchanged

topics.example: Leasing vacant agricultural land with a storage shed to a farmer for growing wheat is exempt from GST.
remember: Milling paddy into rice changes essential characteristics and is NOT an exempt agricultural process.
mistakes: Treating processed items like black tea, roasted coffee, jaggery, or dehusked pulses as raw agricultural produce.

quiz.q: Which of the following agriculture-related services is TAXABLE under GST?
o: Custom milling of paddy into rice
quiz.why: Milling of paddy into rice is not an intermediate farm process and alters essential characteristics, so it is taxable.

quiz.q: Rearing of which animal is specifically EXCLUDED from agricultural exemptions under Entry 54?
quiz.why: Entry 54 covers rearing of all life forms of animals except the rearing of horses.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Educational Services
explain: Services provided BY an educational institution (EI) to students, faculty, staff, or as entrance fees are exempt.
EI includes pre-school to higher secondary, approved vocational courses (specified ITI/NCVET trades), and recognized degree courses.
Input services TO pre-schools and schools (transport, catering/mid-day meals, security/housekeeping) are exempt.
Input services of admission/conduct of exams and supply of online journals are exempt for higher institutions (journals only for degree courses).
Private coaching institutes, unapproved private ITI courses, and foreign degree courses are fully taxable.

flow.title: Educational Institution Exemption Check
steps: Check if entity meets Educational Institution definition
If Output service to students/faculty grant exemption
If Input service check school level eligibility
Auxiliary school inputs exempt under Entry 66b

topics.example: A private bus operator providing student pick-and-drop services to a higher secondary school provides an exempt service.
remember: Auxiliary input services (transport, catering, security) are exempt ONLY when supplied to schools up to higher secondary level.
mistakes: Assuming private coaching centers qualify as Educational Institutions under GST exemption rules.

quiz.q: Catering services supplied to which of the following educational institutions are exempt from GST?
quiz.why: Catering input services are exempt only when supplied to institutions providing pre-school or school education up to higher secondary level.

quiz.q: Short-duration executive development programs (less than 1 year) provided by IIMs are:
quiz.why: Short-duration programs (less than 1 year) by IIMs do not lead to a recognized qualification and are taxable.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Health Care Services
explain: Health care services by clinical establishments, authorised medical practitioners, or paramedics are exempt.
Health care service means diagnosis, treatment, or care for illness, injury, deformity, or pregnancy in recognized systems of medicine.
Recognized systems include Allopathy, Yoga, Naturopathy, Ayurveda, Homeopathy, Siddha, Unani, or Central Government recognized systems.
Ambulance transport and IVF (Assisted Reproductive Technology) procedures are exempt health care services.
Hospital room rent exceeding ₹5,000 per day (excluding ICU/CCU/ICCU/NICU), hair transplants, and cosmetic surgeries are TAXABLE.

flow.title: Health Care Exemption Evaluation
steps: Service provided in recognized system of medicine
Check if procedure is cosmetic or non-restorative
Check hospital room daily charges per patient
If room charge exceeds ₹5000 non-ICU tax applies

topics.example: A hospital charging ₹4,000 per day for an in-patient room provides an exempt service, but charging ₹6,000 per day attracts GST on room rent.
remember: Non-ICU hospital room rent exceeding ₹5,000 per day is taxable under GST.
mistakes: Believing ALL services supplied TO a hospital are exempt; exemption applies to services provided BY clinical establishments.

quiz.q: Which system of medicine is NOT recognized for claiming health care service exemption under GST?
quiz.why: Reiki healing is not a recognized system of medicine under Section 2(h) of the Clinical Establishments Act, 2010.

quiz.q: Hospital room rent charged to an in-patient becomes taxable if room charges per day exceed:
quiz.why: Entry 74(a) proviso taxes room charges exceeding ₹5,000 per day (excluding ICU/CCU/ICCU/NICU).

topics.title: Exempt Services: Services Provided by Government
explain: Activities in relation to functions entrusted to Municipalities (Article 243W) and Panchayats (Article 243G) by governmental authorities are exempt.

General services by Government/local authorities are exempt, EXCEPT specified services: Posts, Railways, aircraft/vessels at ports, transport of goods/passengers, and services to large business entities.
Services to business entities with turnover up to registration threshold limit are exempt (except renting of immovable property and specified services).
Services where consideration does not exceed ₹5,000 (or ₹5,000/year for continuous supply) are exempt.
Statutory registrations, testing/safety checks, passports, visas, driving licenses, birth/death certificates, and tolerating non-performance fines are exempt.

flow.title: Government Service Taxability Check
steps: Check if service is specified service (Posts Railways Ports)
If specified service it is taxable
If non-specified check recipient entity aggregate turnover
If turnover below threshold or fee ≤ ₹5000 exempt

topics.example: Liquidated damages paid by a private builder to the Public Works Department for delay in project completion are exempt under Entry 62.
remember: Government services to small business entities (turnover up to registration limit) are exempt, except renting of immovable property and specified services.
mistakes: Assuming all postal services are taxable; basic post cards, inland letters, book post, and ordinary post (< 10g) are exempt.

quiz.q: Services provided by Government to a business entity are exempt if the aggregate turnover of the business entity in the preceding FY is up to:
quiz.why: Entry 7 exempts Government services to business entities whose aggregate turnover in the preceding FY makes them eligible for registration exemption.

quiz.q: Which of the following postal services provided by the Department of Posts is EXEMPT from GST?
o: Ordinary post weighing less than 10 grams
quiz.why: Entry 24C specifically exempts post cards, inland letters, book post, and ordinary post weighing less than 10 grams.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Construction Services
explain: Pure labour contracts for construction/alteration pertaining to beneficiary-led house construction under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) are exempt.
Pure labour contracts of original works pertaining to a single residential unit (otherwise than as part of a residential complex) are exempt.
Services by Electricity Distribution Utilities extending distribution networks up to farmers' tube wells for agricultural use are exempt.
Original works include new constructions, additions/alterations to damaged structures to make them workable, and plant/equipment installation.

flow.title: Construction Exemption Assessment
steps: Check if contract is pure labour contract
Determine if work pertains to single residential unit or PMAY
Verify project is not part of multi-unit complex
Grant exemption under Entry 10 or 11

topics.example: A pure labour contract for building an independent single-family house (not inside a multi-unit housing complex) is exempt from GST.
remember: Exemption applies strictly to pure labour contracts, not contracts involving supply of construction materials.
mistakes: Thinking pure labour contracts for constructing an apartment within a multi-unit residential complex are exempt.

quiz.q: Pure labour contracts for construction of original works are exempt if they pertain to:
o: A single residential unit outside a residential complex
An apartment in a multi-story residential complex
quiz.why: Entry 11 exempts pure labour contracts of original works pertaining to a single residential unit otherwise than as part of a residential complex.

quiz.q: Pure labour contracts under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) are exempt for which vertical?
o: Beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement
quiz.why: Entry 10 specifically exempts pure labour contracts pertaining to beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement under PMAY.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Passenger Transportation Services
explain: Air transport in economy class embarking from or terminating in North-Eastern states or Bagdogra is exempt.
Non-AC contract carriages (excluding tourism/charter) and non-AC stage carriages are exempt (unless supplied through ECOs).
Air transport under Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS) is exempt for 3 years from commencement against Viability Gap Funding (VGF).
Passenger transport by railways (non-AC / non-first class), metro, monorail, tramway, inland waterways, and non-tourism public vessels is exempt.
Metered cabs and auto-rickshaws (including e-rickshaws) are exempt (unless supplied through ECOs).

flow.title: Passenger Transport Exemption Test
steps: Identify mode of passenger transportation
If Railway check coach class non-AC non-first exempt
If Bus/Cab check AC status and tourism intent
If metered cab check if booking is via ECO

topics.example: Travelling by sleeper class or general unreserved coach on Indian Railways is exempt from GST.
remember: Passenger transport by metered cabs or auto-rickshaws loses exemption if supplied through an Electronic Commerce Operator (ECO).
mistakes: Assuming air travel in business class to North-Eastern states is exempt; only economy class is exempt.

quiz.q: Which railway travel class is EXEMPT from GST under Entry 17?
quiz.why: Entry 17(a) exempts railway passenger transport in classes other than first class or air-conditioned coaches.

quiz.q: Air transportation of passengers embarking from Delhi and terminating in Assam is exempt if booked in:
quiz.why: Entry 15(a) exempts air transport embarking from or terminating in North-Eastern states specifically in economy class.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Goods Transportation Services
explain: Goods transport by road (except GTA and courier agency) and inland waterways is exempt.
Local delivery services provided by or through an Electronic Commerce Operator (ECO) are NOT exempt under Entry 18.

Goods transport by rail, vessel, or GTA is exempt for specified items: agricultural produce, milk, salt, food grains (flours, pulses, rice), organic manure, newspapers/magazines, relief materials, and defence equipment.
GTA services provided to unregistered end-consumers are exempt under Entry 21A.
GTA services to specified registered recipients (factories, societies, body corporates, partnership firms, registered persons) are taxable.
Individual truck operators who do not issue consignment notes are not GTAs and are exempt under Entry 18.

flow.title: GTA Service Taxability Determination
steps: Check if transporter issues consignment note
If no consignment note exempt under Entry 18
If consignment note issued check goods category
If specified goods exempt if other check recipient

topics.example: A Goods Transport Agency transporting organic manure or raw agricultural produce by road is completely exempt from GST.
remember: Issuance of a consignment note is the essential test to classify a road transporter as a Goods Transport Agency (GTA).
mistakes: Confusing individual truck drivers with GTAs; individual truck owners who do not issue consignment notes are exempt under Entry 18.

quiz.q: Which of the following goods, when transported by a Goods Transport Agency (GTA), is EXEMPT from GST?
quiz.why: Entry 21 specifically exempts GTA transportation of organic manure, agricultural produce, milk, salt, food grains, relief materials, and defence equipment.

quiz.q: Services provided by a GTA to an unregistered individual end-consumer for personal household movement are:
quiz.why: Entry 21A exempts GTA services provided to unregistered persons (including casual taxable persons) other than specified registered entities.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Banking & Financial Services
explain: Extending deposits, loans, or advances where consideration is interest or discount is exempt (except credit card interest).
Inter se sale/purchase of foreign currency between banks or authorized dealers is exempt.
Services by banks to Basic Saving Bank Deposit (BSBD) account holders under PM Jan Dhan Yojana are exempt.
Services by acquiring banks for payment card settlements up to ₹2,000 in a single transaction are exempt.
Intermediary financial services in IFSC SEZ to foreign customers in foreign currency are exempt.
Loan processing fees, bank guarantee commissions, credit card late fees, and minimum balance charges are TAXABLE.
Penal interest charged by banks for delayed loan repayments is exempt as interest when provided by the financial lender.

flow.title: Bank Service Taxability Evaluation
steps: Is consideration represented as interest or discount
If yes exempt under Entry 27 except credit card
If separate service fee or processing fee levied
Fee portion is taxable consideration under GST

topics.example: Interest earned on a home loan or fixed deposit is exempt from GST, but loan processing fees charged by the bank are taxable.
remember: Interest involved in credit card services is specifically EXCLUDED from exemption and is taxable.
mistakes: Treating loan processing fees or bank guarantee commissions as exempt interest.

quiz.q: Which of the following banking income items is TAXABLE under GST?
o: Processing fees collected on loan sanction
quiz.why: Processing fees are service charges collected over and above interest and represent taxable consideration.

quiz.q: Card transaction settlement services by an acquiring bank are exempt if the single transaction amount is up to:
quiz.why: Entry 34 exempts acquiring bank settlement services for card transactions up to ₹2,000 in a single transaction.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Insurance Services & Pension Schemes
explain: Life insurance under NPS, armed forces group funds, and specified government schemes (Janashree, PMJJBY, PMJDY, micro-insurance up to ₹2 lakh cover) is exempt.
Individual life insurance (Entry 36C) and individual health insurance (Entry 36D) provided to an individual or family are exempt.
Group life or health insurance policies (e.g. employer-employee group plans) are TAXABLE.
Reinsurance of non-group life and health insurance policies is exempt under Entry 36E.
Specified general insurance schemes (PM Fasal Bima, Cattle insurance, Weather Based Crop Insurance, Hut Insurance) and their reinsurance are exempt.
Collection of contribution under Atal Pension Yojana and State Government pension schemes is exempt.

flow.title: Insurance Policy Exemption Check
steps: Identify insurance category life health general
Check if policy falls under specified Government scheme
If private life or health check if individual family or group
Individual family policy exempt group policy taxable

topics.example: An individual purchasing a health insurance policy covering himself, his wife, and children is exempt under Entry 36D.
remember: Individual life and health insurance policies (non-group) are exempt, but employer-employee group health insurance is taxable.
mistakes: Believing employer-employee group health insurance policies are exempt under Entry 36D.

quiz.q: A company obtains a group health insurance policy for all its employees and pays the premium. This policy is:
quiz.why: Entry 36D exempts health insurance provided to an insured where the insured is NOT a group. Employer-employee group plans are taxable.

quiz.q: Life micro-insurance products approved by IRDA are exempt from GST if the maximum amount of cover is up to:
quiz.why: Entry 36(c) exempts life micro-insurance products approved by IRDA having a maximum cover amount of ₹2,00,000.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Business Facilitator / Correspondent
explain: Services by a Business Facilitator (BF) or Business Correspondent (BC) to a banking company regarding accounts in its rural area branch are exempt.
Services by an intermediary to a BF/BC regarding rural branch banking accounts are exempt.
Services by a BF or BC to an insurance company in a rural area are exempt.
Services by BF/BC to urban bank branches are TAXABLE, and GST is payable by the bank under reverse charge.
Banking companies are service providers to ultimate customers and cannot shift tax liabilities to rural customers.

flow.title: BF/BC Service Exemption Criteria
steps: Determine entity receiving BF or BC service
Identify branch location urban versus rural area
If rural branch accounts service is exempt
If urban branch service is taxable under RCM

topics.example: A Business Correspondent helping villagers open accounts in a rural bank branch provides an exempt service.
remember: Exemption for BF/BC banking services applies ONLY to rural branch accounts.
mistakes: Assuming BF/BC services provided for urban bank branches are exempt from GST.

quiz.q: Services provided by a Business Facilitator (BF) to a banking company are EXEMPT from GST with respect to:
o: Accounts in its urban area branch
Accounts in its rural area branch
Corporate loan accounts in metro cities
quiz.why: Entry 39(a) exempts BF/BC services to a banking company specifically with respect to accounts in its rural area branch.

quiz.q: Who is liable to pay GST on taxable services provided by a Business Facilitator to a banking company in an urban area?
quiz.why: For taxable BF services supplied to a banking company, the banking company is liable to pay GST under reverse charge mechanism.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Services Provided to Government
explain: Pure services (no goods involved) provided TO Central/State Govt, UT, or local authority for functions under Article 243G/243W are exempt under Entry 3.
Composite supplies of goods and services provided TO Government for Panchayat/Municipality functions where value of goods ≤ 25% are exempt under Entry 3A.
Services to Governmental Authorities for water supply, public health, sanitation, solid waste management, and slum improvement are exempt under Entry 3B.
Services by Fair Price Shops under Public Distribution System (PDS) against commission/margin are exempt.
Insurance schemes fully funded by Government, and training programmes where 75% or more expenditure is borne by Government, are exempt.

flow.title: Testing Exemption for Services to Government
steps: Check if service recipient is Government or Local Authority
Verify relation to Article 243G or 243W functions
If pure service grant exemption under Entry 3
If composite supply check goods value limit ≤ 25%

topics.example: Supply of manpower for cleanliness of public roads provided to a Municipal Corporation is an exempt pure service under Entry 3.
remember: For composite supplies to Government under Entry 3A, value of goods must NOT exceed 25% of total supply value.
mistakes: Assuming general office facility management provided to Government headquarters (not directly linked to 243G/243W public functions) is exempt.

quiz.q: A composite supply of goods and services to Government is exempt under Entry 3A if the value of goods constitutes not more than what percentage of the supply value?
quiz.why: Entry 3A requires the value of supply of goods to constitute not more than 25% of the value of the composite supply.

quiz.q: Training programmes provided to Government administration are exempt under Entry 72 if the expenditure borne by Government is at least:
quiz.why: Entry 72 exempts training programmes where 75% or more of the total expenditure is borne by the Government administration.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Leasing, Legal, & Sponsorship Services
explain: Upfront lease premium for long-term lease (≥ 30 years) of industrial plots by State Industrial Corporations or 20%+ Govt entities is exempt.
Legal services by arbitral tribunals, non-senior advocates, or advocate firms to non-business entities, small businesses (turnover ≤ threshold limit), or Government are exempt.
Legal services by non-senior advocates to another advocate or advocate firm are exempt.
Legal services by senior advocates to non-business entities, small businesses, or Government are exempt (services to another advocate are taxable).
Sponsorship of sporting events organized by national sports federations, AIU, School Games Federation, Paralympic Committee, or Olympic Association is exempt.

flow.title: Legal Service Exemption Check
steps: Identify legal service provider and recipient status
If recipient is non-business or small business exempt
If recipient is large business entity taxable under RCM
Non-senior advocate to advocate firm is exempt

topics.example: An advocate providing legal consultancy to a salaried individual for a personal property dispute provides an exempt service.
remember: Legal services provided to business entities with turnover exceeding registration threshold limit are taxable under reverse charge.
mistakes: Assuming legal services provided by a senior advocate to a non-senior advocate are exempt; that exemption applies only to non-senior advocates.

quiz.q: Legal services provided by an advocate firm to a business entity with aggregate turnover of ₹ 80 lakh in preceding FY in Delhi are:
o: Taxable under reverse charge payable by business entity
quiz.why: Legal services supplied to a business entity whose turnover exceeds threshold exemption limit are taxable under reverse charge.

quiz.q: Upfront premium for long-term lease of industrial plots is exempt under Entry 41 if lease duration is at least:
quiz.why: Entry 41 grants exemption on upfront amounts payable for granting long-term lease of 30 years or more.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Skill Development & Performing Artists
explain: Skill development services provided by NSDC, NCVET, recognized Awarding Bodies, Assessment Agencies, or Training Bodies under national skill programs are exempt.
Assessment under SDI scheme and training under DDUGKY implemented by Ministry of Rural Development are exempt.
Performance by an artist in folk or classical art forms of music, dance, or theatre is exempt if consideration ≤ ₹1,50,000.
If artist consideration exceeds ₹1,50,000, the ENTIRE amount is taxable.
Performances in modern/western art forms, still arts (paintings, sculptures), or performances as a brand ambassador are TAXABLE regardless of amount.

flow.title: Artist Performance Exemption Test
steps: Verify performance in folk or classical music dance theatre
Check if performance is as brand ambassador
If brand ambassador performance is fully taxable
If non-ambassador check fee ≤ ₹150000 exempt

topics.example: A classical Kathak dancer charging ₹1,40,000 for a cultural stage show is exempt, but charging ₹1,60,000 makes the full ₹1,60,000 taxable.
remember: The ₹1,50,000 threshold for performing artists applies per performance and only to classical/folk music, dance, or theatre.
mistakes: Believing only the excess over ₹1,50,000 is taxed when artist fee exceeds ₹1,50,000; the ENTIRE consideration becomes taxable.

quiz.q: A classical singer gives a Carnatic music performance in a concert and charges ₹ 1,40,000. Is this performance exempt from GST?
o: No, because music concerts are always taxable
Yes, because classical music performance fee does not exceed ₹ 1,50,000
No, because classical music is not covered
Yes, only if organized by Government
quiz.why: Entry 78 exempts classical art performances of music where consideration charged is not more than ₹1,50,000.

quiz.q: If a film actress gives a classical dance performance as a brand ambassador for a soap company for ₹ 1,20,000, the performance is:
o: Taxable because brand ambassador services are excluded from exemption
quiz.why: Entry 78 explicitly states that exemption shall not apply to services provided by an artist as a brand ambassador.

topics.title: Exempt Services: Admission to Events & Unincorporated Bodies/RWAs
explain: Admission to museums, national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, tiger reserves, zoos, and protected national monuments is exempt.
Admission to circus, dance, theatrical performances, award functions, concerts, planetariums, or recognized sporting events is exempt if ticket ≤ ₹500/person.
Services by RWAs/housing societies to members for sourcing goods/services for common use are exempt up to ₹7,500 per month per member.
If RWA monthly maintenance exceeds ₹7,500 per member, GST (18%) is payable on the FULL amount (if total RWA turnover > ₹20 lakh/₹10 lakh).
Statutory dues (property tax, electricity) are excluded from ₹7,500 limit calculation.
Non-profit entities promoting trade, commerce, labour welfare, sports, education, or environment are exempt for membership fees up to ₹1,000/member/year.

flow.title: RWA Maintenance Exemption Evaluation
steps: Check RWA annual aggregate turnover > ₹20 lakh
If turnover ≤ threshold limit tax not payable
If turnover > threshold check monthly fee per member
If fee > ₹7500 tax payable on full amount

topics.example: An RWA with annual turnover of ₹50 lakh collects ₹6,000/month per member for maintenance; the supply is exempt from GST.
remember: If RWA maintenance exceeds ₹7,500/month, GST is calculated on the full amount, not just the excess over ₹7,500.
mistakes: Calculating RWA GST only on the amount exceeding ₹7,500; GST applies on the entire monthly fee if it crosses ₹7,500.

quiz.q: Admission ticket to a circus or award function is exempt from GST if the ticket consideration per person does not exceed:
quiz.why: Entry 81 exempts right to admission to circus, dance, award functions, concerts etc. where ticket fee is not more than ₹500 per person.

quiz.q: A registered RWA collects ₹ 9,000 per month per member as maintenance charges. GST @ 18% is payable on:
quiz.why: When RWA monthly maintenance charges exceed ₹7,500 per member, GST is payable on the entire amount of ₹9,000.

topics.title: Other Exempt Services
explain: Transfer of a going concern as a whole or independent part (slump sale) is exempt.
Renting residential dwelling for use as residence to an UNREGISTERED person is exempt (commercial renting or renting to registered persons is taxable).
Short-term accommodation up to ₹20,000/person/month for continuous minimum 90 days is exempt.
Satellite launch services (ISRO, Antrix, private start-ups like OrbitNova) are exempt.
Hiring motor vehicles (>12 passengers) to STUs/local authorities (EOV), goods transport vehicles to GTA, and student transport vehicles to school transporters are exempt.
Toll charges (including overloading charges and non-Fastag double toll fees) and transmission/distribution of electricity are exempt.

Incubatee services (turnover ≤ ₹50 lakh for 3 years), R&D grants to notified institutions, public library book lending, news collection/provision by independent journalists/PTI/UNI, foreign exhibitions, cold chain knowledge dissemination by NCCD, foreign diplomatic missions, RTI info, and public conveniences (toilets) are exempt.

flow.title: Residential Dwelling Renting Exemption Test
steps: Check property status as residential dwelling
Verify property rented for residential use
Check tenant registration status unregistered person
If all met renting service is exempt

topics.example: A landlord renting a residential flat to an unregistered salaried employee for personal residence provides an exempt service under Entry 12.
remember: Renting residential dwelling to a registered person is taxable under reverse charge mechanism.
mistakes: Assuming renting residential premises for commercial office space is exempt because the property is residential.

quiz.q: Renting of a residential dwelling is EXEMPT from GST when rented to:
o: A registered private limited company for manager residence
An unregistered salaried individual for personal residence
A registered partnership firm for office use
A registered sole proprietor for business use
quiz.why: Entry 12 exempts renting of residential dwelling for use as residence except where rented to a registered person.

quiz.q: Services provided by way of access to a road or a bridge on payment of toll charges are:
o: Taxable only if overloading charges collected
quiz.why: Entry 23 exempts service by way of access to a road or a bridge on payment of toll charges (including overloading fees).
